description: This Java class 'RqlPredicateParser' implements the 'PredicateParser' interface to parse predicates written in the RQL (Resource Query Language) syntax. It utilizes a static parser instance to parse input strings into an abstract syntax tree rooted at 'RootNode'. The class serves as an adapter to invoke the underlying parser and adheres to the RQL standard as described in the linked specification.

classes.name: RqlPredicateParser
classes.description: Java class implementing RQL predicate parsing, acting as an adapter over a static parser instance.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an RQL predicate string into a RootNode AST node using the underlying parser instance.
